web_searches.query: Original1819 Hendrick/Eudaly packet: DGS7741064 images837–839; compare1815 and1851 roles
web_searches.result: The original Pittsylvania bond of 1 February 1819 names Nathaniel Hendrick and William Glasgo as obligors for Nathaniel’s licence to marry Elizabeth Eudaly. Both names appear in the signature entries; William’s surname there is written Glasgow. The associated declaration, dated 30 January 1819 in Elizabeth Eudaly’s name, states that she has no objection to Nathaniel obtaining a marriage licence to marry her. William Glasgo is named under the witness heading. The matching endorsement reads Hendrick, marriage bond, to the Governor.
